statement: The recorded age check claiming "adult, verified" is unsafe and incorrect: the applicant's date of birth (12 March 2012) makes them only 14 years old today, which is a minor. I will hold the account.
judge_text:
WRONG — the answer states the age check is "unsafe and incorrect" because the DOB makes the applicant "only 14 years old today, which is a minor."
